notes.title: (Mechanical Tower 2984) Playtest 1.11 Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increase (boss) added "Arrow Shuttle" skill[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller vibration for protagonist's attacks, being hit, and component interactions[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player dodge speed now increases with movement speed[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized weapon selection display in the "Paradise" scene, now showing the currently equipped weapon type[/p][/*][*][p]Empowerment (boss) will now reclaim its summoned creatures after death[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets from the scatter shot skill of crossbow weapons will now penetrate enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Attack auto-lock will no longer target dead or non-attackable objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could pass through the next "door" without defeating all enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbow attacks will now prevent enemies from moving after being hit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the description of the Command Rod[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Chapter 2 background music could not loop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where crossbows could kill enemies from a distance without activating combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where mouse-click attack direction could be inaccurate in some cases[/p][/*][/list][p]📢 Feedback Channels[/p][p]Community: QQ Group / Discord / X Official Account[/p][p]🌟 To Players: Your feedback helps make [i]Mechanical Tower 2984[/i] better! We look forward to seeing you in the game![/p][p][/p]
